logp.method_description: The hydro/lipophilic nature of the radioconjugates was evaluated by the ‘‘shake-flask’’ method, which consists of determining the distribution coefficient (log D7.4) in the biphasic system n-octanol/PBS 0.1 M, pH 7.4. (54) Briefly, the [99mTc]Tc-radiocomplexes [99mTc]TcL0–[99mTc]TcL8 (approximately 0.37 MBq) were added to a 1:1 mixture of octanol (1 mL) and 0.1 M PBS pH 7.4 (1 mL), previously saturated in each other by vigorously stirring. This mixture was vortexed for approximately 5 min and sequentially centrifuged (2000g, 10 min, r. t.) to allow phase separation. Aliquots of both octanol and PBS were counted in a Hidex AMG Automatic Gamma Counter. The Doct/PBS was calculated by dividing the counts in the octanol phase by those in the buffer, and the results expressed as log Doct/PBS. Evaluation of the partition coefficient was performed with three replicates per radiocomplex each with at least three aliquots per phase.
